rows.en: ...Just remembering it does that to you? Must've been pretty bad. But you seem fine, OOO.
Nah... I couldn't take it either if I were back there. Not as bad as W, though.
Did you find any good items?
We've got to get them back before the enemy can use them.
Looks like OOO's Core Medals ended up in our hands before the "Xtreme Memory" did, huh.
Yeah.
Sorry.
Don't apologize. Even if you're the only one getting stronger, there's somebody it'll save.
You're the one who said "Riders help each other out," aren't you?
Hey! OOO!
Huh, Birth...? Weren't you off with the separate unit, doing an undercover investigation...?
Come on, even I deserve a break once in a while~
Truth is, we can't get any further, so I'm stumped. That exhibit room door... if only it'd open.
Hey! Birth, quit slacking off! We're going back in!
Okay, okay! Geez, Accel, you're such a slave driver!
I wondered why Accel hadn't come by today. So he'd snuck into the Cube with the separate unit.
Yeah, that's right. But it sounds like he's already moving with the main team now.
I see. So? What are you up to?
Me? I'm guarding the base, gathering intel on the Cubes... this and that, y'know.
Oh yeah, in the "Begins Cube," there was the corpse of a monster with no arms, y'know?
And a monster corpse with nothing from the neck up, too. What the heck was that about?
...Accel's okay. Sure, he took a lot of damage, but
he's fully conscious, and... no, if anything, his spirit's second to nobody's.
He's really something.
Have you found the Gaia Gate?
At times like that, maybe it's a good idea to walk right into one of the enemy's traps.
What'd you say? Hey, Turtle! Quit spoutin' stuff that makes no sense!
Sempai, you're not too bright, so just keep quiet.
Wha...! You sure say some nasty stuff like it's nothin', y'know.
For example... try falling into a pitfall.
See, I think the pitfalls are traps meant to fool our eyes.
Seems the enemy's giant particle cannon has this place in its sights, huh?
Yeah! I hear they called in the Gundams to smash that cannon.
Having them around is reassuring.
Keh!! If ya ask me, those guys are still a buncha softies.
Even so, if there are enough of them, they'll make a decent fighting force, won't they?
Then havin' ten of me around would be way more useful!
Ten Sempais!? ...I'd rather not see that.
...I see, so you managed to join up with the Gundams.
The enemy's coming at us with sheer numbers, so we'll have to join forces too.
...What is it? I'm busy right now.
What am I doing? Checking that every facility on the base is working.
That bombardment just now might have caused trouble in places we'd never expect.
Don't worry! Leave the base to me!!
...Ugh, the back room's a total wreck now.
Aaah, I thought I was gonna die!
If we take another hit like that, we're done for!
I won't be able to serve coffee for a while, so bear with me, okay?
...So, what exactly is this Death Army?
The Devil Gundam's loyal minions. Mobile suits spawned from DG Cells.
Is their job to guard the Devil Gundam?
That's their main role, yes.
Then the Devil Gundam might be somewhere nearby.
...Looks like you beat the Devil Gundam. But I hear DG Cells don't disappear that easily.
I heard this while the enemy had me captive... DG Cells, if I remember right,
have the abilities of "Self-Regeneration," "Self-Multiplication," and "Self-Evolution."
In other words, if you don't finish it off completely, there's a risk it'll come right back.
I hear the Gundam Team's in a pinch! Hurry and get over there!!
The Gundam Team smashed the cannon for us! Now we can relax, right?
What are you talking about? The Libra Cannon and the Colony Laser are still out there, you know?
Yeah! The Libra Cannon comes first. Don't worry. I'll stop it for sure!!
You're telling me the Libra Cannon's energy charge is over 80%?
What are you dawdling for!! Go stop it right now!!
We'll shore up the base's defenses and be ready for the worst, too!!
You did it!! Great job destroying the Libra Cannon!!
...Whoa, we can't just celebrate yet. The Colony Laser is still out there, isn't it?
The Colony Laser is shaped kinda like a big tube, right?
Yeah, seems so. So why d'you wanna know what it looks like?
'Cause I'm drawing a picture of the Colony Laser~♪
You've got zero sense of urgency!!
I hear Seravee's group got spotted by the enemy on their way to Veda?
Getting ready for battle matters too, but we don't really have time for this, do we?
A little while ago, I heard some strange "voice"... like it was ringing right inside my brain...
...So that was Seravee.
So it's finally the showdown with Belial.
...Come to think of it, was Dinosaur Greeed there?
Ikadevil mentioned him, didn't he?
Yes, I know. He spoke that name as he was dying.
Belial and Dinosaur Greeed... Fearsome opponents.
That's not all. The Devil Gundam must be lurking somewhere, too.

notes.note: OOO answering Urataros: he was in the 'swamp of fear' too (#0.397); 'sono ba ni itara' read as 'if I were back there'. 'Not as bad as W' = his reaction would be milder than W's.
Xtreme Memory per glossary; quotes kept from source. 'te-shimatta' (ended up / sooner than expected) carried by 'ended up'.
Shotaro to OOO. Literally 'if even just you get stronger, there are people who'll be saved'; subject 'somebody' restored.
Separate unit = betsudoutai, as in story_102/103 (Accel and Birth sent in as a separate unit).
Exhibit room = Monster Zoo tenjishitsu, matching dungeon labels ('Exhibit Room').
Birth calls Accel 'Accel-chan' (teasing); honorific dropped per style, teasing carried by 'Geez'.
Rider 2. 'Now they're already moving together' read as Accel having joined the main team (story_103: Accel and Birth go with the heroes). Uncertain: could mean Accel and Birth together.
'Kubi kara ue no nai' = headless; no pronouns used for the corpse.
Sentence runs on into #0.453; cut at the same point.
Urataros replying to an implied 'not yet' about the Gaia Gate; 'sonna toki wa' = at times like that.
Kame-kou -> 'Turtle' as established.
Ama-chan (naive softie/greenhorn) -> 'softies'.
Sempai = Momotaros (Imagin usage).
#0.503/#0.504 have no script speaker (None); assigned to Rider 2, whose Talk01_43 lines #0.505/#0.506 continue the same speech.
God Gundam (Domon). Death Army, DG Cells per glossary. Devil Gundam g=n -> 'it' (#0.544).
Rider 2 was captured by Shocker in the story (talk_005 #0.182 note). Sentence runs into #0.543; cut at the same point. Ability names per glossary with quotes kept.
Ryutaros; 'the cannon' = the giant particle cannon from #0.481/482.
Rider 2 reacting to a report ('da tte?' = you're telling me...?).
Ryutaros's music note kept as in source.
Kinchoukan nee na = no sense of tension/urgency.
Veda as in earlier story slices; 'Seravee-tachi' -> 'Seravee's group'.
Rider 2. The 'voice' heard directly in the brain = Seravee (quantum brainwaves); quotes kept.
Rider 2 continues; 'him' = Dinosaur Greeed (g=m). #0.627 'He' = Ikadevil (g=m), who named Dinosaur Greeed when dying.
Labelled Rider 1 by the script; kept.

report: 80/80 rows. Speakers taken from tools/talkspk.py Quest; #0.503/#0.504 had no speaker and were assigned to Rider 2 (same speech as #0.505/506). Uncertain: #0.441 who Accel is now moving with (read as the main team). No new glossary names; 'separate unit', 'exhibit room', 'giant particle cannon', 'pitfall' follow earlier slices.
